findings.section: README 'Status' paragraph and 'Development' Workflow paragraph; master §17 'Implemented Rust contract'
findings.causal_reproduction: At 12cc972 the README Status paragraph says the staged formal-refusal design 'is not implemented; legacy single-reviewer behavior remains current'. The README Development paragraph and master §17 likewise describe the current reviewer delegation and the QUICK PR→merge/cleanup finalization as executable. The same README later states that the staged component returns ReviewGatingUnavailable, and workflow.rs at this head refuses every Reviewer phase, Pr/MergeGate/Cleanup and request_finalization. A reader of the Status line would wrongly conclude that legacy single-reviewer gating still works on this source.
findings.source_basis: workflow.rs require_formal_review_ready, called from step, prepare_pack, evaluate, apply_outcome(Passed), retry, resume_gate and request_finalization. The I9-AC-21.j wording requires README/status to honestly distinguish unavailable formal gating.
findings.minimal_fix: Reword the README Status sentence and the master §17 baseline sentence to say: on the staged Issue9 source, formal Review/Pr/MergeGate/Cleanup/finalization consumers return ReviewGatingUnavailable; legacy single-reviewer behavior describes main/history only. Make no source change.

findings.causal_reproduction: At SOURCE1 the Status section says the staged formal-refusal design 'is not implemented; legacy single-reviewer behavior remains current'. findings.source_basis: README Status paragraph versus the README paragraph 'The staged Issue #9 formal-refusal component returns typed ReviewGatingUnavailable...', crates/rrx/src/workflow.rs require_formal_review_ready and its callsites, and the I9-AC-21.j/21.k requirement that README/status state the withdrawal honestly. findings.minimal_fix: Replace the stale Status sentence with the same staged wording: the selected typed refusal source is staged and not source-qualified, and it holds new formal review and Pr/MergeGate/Cleanup/finalization consumers. Do not add any readiness claim.

findings.causal_reproduction:
The controls do not cover:
- STRICT RequirementsReview, DesignReview or ImplementationReview initial-step refusal.
- STANDARD/STRICT RequirementsReview, DesignReview or SecurityReview through retry and resume_gate. retry is exercised only for QUICK ImplementationReview; resume_gate only for STANDARD ImplementationReview plus downstream phases.
No bug results today, because the guard keys only on Phase::actor()/irreversible and not on class. A future class-dependent change, however, would not be caught for those combinations.
findings.source_basis: The I9-AC-21.j test enumeration ('RequirementsReview/DesignReview/ImplementationReview/SecurityReview under QUICK/STANDARD/STRICT initial/retry/resume_gate/request_finalization where applicable') versus the target lists in formal_entry_refuses..., retry_review_refuses... and resume_refuses.... Speculative coverage gap, not a verified defect.
findings.minimal_fix: Parameterize the existing formal_entry, retry and resume controls over every configured Reviewer phase for each class, reusing history_before/reserve_history/journal with the same database()/counts() assertions. Add no new readiness path and claim no new mutation credit.
